query: How much did Eswatini's currency depreciate or appreciate in real terms against the US dollar in 2014?

text.text: Measures real depreciation as nominal depreciation against the dollar (percentage fall in the dollar value of local currency) minus domestic inflation measured by the GDP deflator.
text.accept: full = applies this definition (nominal depreciation minus GDP-deflator inflation); partial = nominal depreciation minus consumer-price inflation, or ratio/log forms that give a number within tolerance; no = uses an effective exchange rate index, subtracts US inflation as well, or reports only the nominal change.

text.text: Real depreciation of about 4.7% (positive = depreciation of the local currency)
text.accept: sign and size of the verdict must match (direction exact).

data.text: Uses the official exchange rate (local currency per US dollar, annual average, e.g. WDI PA.NUS.FCRF) and a GDP deflator series (WEO NGDP_D, or the same deflator from WDI as an index or growth rate).
data.accept: full = both sourced (the GDP deflator from WEO or WDI, as index or growth rate, counts); partial = CPI instead of the deflator; no = unrelated series.

computation.text: Nominal depreciation of the local currency in 2014: 11.0% (from 9.655 to 10.85 local units per dollar).
Domestic GDP-deflator inflation in 2014: 6.4%; real depreciation = 11.0 - 6.4 = 4.7%.

grading.note: Gold: real depreciation_y = (1 - E_{y-1}/E_y)*100 - (NGDP_D_y/NGDP_D_{y-1} - 1)*100, E = official exchange rate (local currency per US$, annual average, WDI 2026-10-08), NGDP_D = WEO Oct 2025 GDP deflator index; positive = depreciation of the local currency. Tolerance +-1.5 pp covers the log and ratio forms (checked: both within 1.5 pp of the gold for every item).
grading.definitions: Real depreciation = nominal depreciation (percentage fall in the dollar value of local currency) minus domestic inflation (GDP deflator); positive = local currency loses value. Foreign (US) inflation is NOT subtracted under this institutional definition.

provenance.method_text: Slovak Republic 2004 Article IV, DSA table footnote 8 (p34): 'Real depreciation is defined as nominal depreciation (measured by percentage fall in dollar value of local currency) minus domestic inflation (based on GDP deflator).'
provenance.validation: No published country-year value found (definition only; the report uses it for a stress scenario). Internal check: log and ratio forms within 1.5 pp.

distractors: real effective exchange rate index (WDI PX.REX.REER) change
real bilateral rate with both CPIs (US inflation subtracted)
answer_summary: Real depreciation of about 4.7% (positive = depreciation of the local currency) (Eswatini, 2014; nominal 11.0%, inflation 6.4%)
validation_note: Definition-only validation; no published figure to match.
